title: ml_decision_entry: is the served model selecting symbols by cost-per-R (volatility) rather than direction? FEATURE-IMPACT M2 shows net_long ranks on atr_pct (+0.49) while raw 24h return ranks the opposite way (-0.08)
note: MEASURED 2026-11-11 (scratch run of feature_impact.py --m2, PR #24996; 60 symbols, 2020-07..2026-09, 13,650 decision timestamps): rank_ic_xs vs net_long: atr_pct +0.486, vol24 +0.423, ret_24 +0.048; vs raw fwd_ret_24h: atr_pct -0.084, vol24 -0.078, ret_24 -0.025. net_long is in R and cost in R = cost_bps / stop distance, so wider-ATR symbols pay less cost per R. INFERRED, not tested: part of the model's selection is a cost-per-R tilt, not a directional signal. That may be legitimate money under per-R sizing, but it is a different claim from direction. NEXT (ml-review): decompose the served model's held-out net R into a vol-bucket tilt vs within-bucket ranking; check whether the gross-R label shows the same feature ranking.
